Subject: Post-call recap + next steps — deployment mode (Hosted vs Dedicated)

Thanks again for the time today — great conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we're aligned: 

Recap from our call
- Primary goal: replace current latency-sensitive inference stack for search and assistant features.
- Traffic profile you shared (Priya): baseline ~300 qps, expected steady-state 500 qps, occasional peaks to ~2000 qps for hourly jobs. Typical request sizes avg ~60 tokens in, ~120 tokens out.
- SLO target: p95 latency <50ms for response tails on the assistant endpoint; aggressive throughput need for search reranking.
- Data sensitivity: customer PII present in requests; compliance needs: SOC 2 + contractual NDA (you mentioned procurement will confirm).

Redwood deployment options — initial recommendation
- Hosted API (fastest onboarding): good for PoC and small-to-medium volume. We can provision initial throughput and run benchmarks quickly. However, for sustained 500 qps with p95 <50ms and bursts to 2000 qps, Hosted may experience noisy neighbor effects unless you move to a Dedicated pool.
- Dedicated capacity (recommended for your profile): reserved GPU pools give predictable throughput, stricter latency SLOs, and isolation for PII. Autoscaling and burst configs can smooth hourly peaks; we can size the pool for your steady-state 500 qps and an autoscale buffer for peaks.
- Private VPC / on-prem: likely unnecessary at this stage given your requirements, but available if procurement requires network isolation or specific KMS/HSM integrations later.

Next steps I propose
1) Can you confirm the target p95 and expected concurrency for the assistant and the search endpoints separately? (Your numbers above were helpful; I want per-endpoint numbers to size properly.)
2) We'll run a short benchmark: Redwood will provision a Hosted test project and run a 2-hour load test mirroring your traffic (we'll submit results + latency distribution).
3) If results show Hosted can't reliably meet p95 <50ms at sustained 500 qps, we'll provide a Dedicated sizing proposal (attached sizing sheet) with estimated committed capacity and monthly cost.
4) Schedule a 30-min follow-up next week to review benchmark results and the Dedicated sizing.

Attachments: redwood-dedicated-sizing-sheet.xlsx (draft sizing guide), ma_plan_draft.pdf (proposed MA steps).

Proposed times for follow-up: Thu 3/12 10:00-11:00 PT or Fri 3/13 09:00-10:00 PT — let me know what works.

Thanks,
Marissa

Thanks Marissa — this is helpful. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Confirming per-endpoint targets:
  - Assistant endpoint: p95 target 45ms, typical concurrency ~40, expected steady qps ~200 (but higher per-user concurrency).
  - Search/rerank endpoint: p95 target 80ms, expected steady qps ~300, but critical to handle spikes to 2k qps for hourly batch indexing and traffic surges.
- Data sensitivity: yes, we have PII and procurement will ask for SOC 2 + contractual language.
- For PoC we are open to Hosted if it can emulate production traffic and we can get a baseline. However, for production we lean Dedicated because of the predictability and isolation.

Can you run the Hosted benchmark against the assistant endpoint pattern first (smaller token size) and we'll share a test API key and a staging dataset? Also please include rough committed capacity pricing in your sizing estimate so procurement can see the delta.
